title: Texas Travel Poster
coreRelationships: The large 'TEXAS' title dominates the upper portion, partially obscured by the cowboy hat.
The cowboy's legs and boots are centrally positioned, acting as a strong vertical element.
The cityscape forms a horizontal band across the lower middle, providing context and depth.
The airplane provides a subtle, dynamic element in the upper-left background.
The 'BRANIFF International AIRWAYS' text anchors the bottom of the composition.
reuseFormula: Recreate a vintage travel poster by layering bold, graphic text ('TEXAS') at the top over a central, large-scale figure (cowboy legs, boots, hat), with a stylized cityscape and subtle airplane silhouette in the mid-ground, all anchored by secondary text ('BRANIFF International AIRWAYS') at the bottom. Utilize a limited palette of warm orange, brown, black, and off-white with strong outlines and minimal detail.
